pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

pages.title: A small card · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday afternoon at a business event in San Francisco. People stand in small groups with cups and cards. Lia holds a stack of her own business cards. She is a little shy but curious. A tall man in a gray jacket smiles at her. He holds out a card with both hands.
“Nice to meet you, Lia. Here is my business card.” says Ty. “Thank you. Here is mine. I work in design.” says Lia. “Great! I work in sales. Do you work from home?” says Ty.
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: A small card · 3/3
paragraphs: “Let’s keep in touch. I’ll send you an email.” says Lia. “Please do. It was great talking to you.” says Ty. Lia reads Ty’s card and puts it in her wallet. They talk for fifteen minutes about work and ideas. Ty introduces her to two other people. At the end, they shake hands and say goodbye. That night, Lia sends Ty a short email. A small card can open a big door.
